summary: Observation tower in Dooly County, listed at 451 (no unit stated) on a Georgia tower list; a map site reads 453 feet for the same OpenStreetMap node; no build, staffing or current-status source found.

evidence.supports: Walton record: Dooly County, coordinates, elevation 451 (no unit stated)
Map site gives the elevation as 453 feet (138 m) for the same point
Map site lists the same OpenStreetMap node (358748756) as the footnoted OSM entry
Map site: the hamlet of Lamb Town about three and a half miles southwest of the tower

sources.title: Walton Lookout Tower Map - Dooly, Georgia, USA

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a list entry, an OpenStreetMap tag and one map-site page. No build date, agency, staffing, fires, history or current status was found in the pages read. The list gives 451 with no unit. The map site gives 453 feet (138 metres) for a point about 50 m west of the list's coordinates, and it lists the same OpenStreetMap node (358748756), so the story compares the two figures as numbers and does not convert the list's figure. The map site's nearby-place list is generated from map data, so treat the Lamb Town distance as approximate. The list has no register numbers for this tower. The story does not name a town for the site because no source read names one. The tnlandforms page names no author, so its footnote gives the site name only.
